nativeAxes.origin: +Y up; +Z panel wall approximately west, opposite -Z door approximately east. Origin is tower-foot center on host terrain. Official photo viewpoint on the western long keeper-house roof, with northwest hipped house to image-left, signs the panel/door opposition; approximate bearing, not surveyed north.

sourceFacts.basis: The project supplies tower location and separate20m navigation-light height. Published survey mesh supplies relative body/lantern dimensions, including20.45m vane tip; its20.75m raw span includes rough ground. No surveyed north axis or EXIF compass was supplied. Solar-wall bearing270degrees true is a photo/context reconstruction with22.5degree uncertainty, not a precise engineering azimuth. OSM keeper-house polygons are contextual controls only, not a lighthouse footprint or part of this model. Clean survey-derived octagonal base is explicitly reconstructed geometry. Detached houses, natural granite shore, exact present paint decay and interior operation are omitted; footprint replacement stays off.

appearance.identity: Red octagonal tower, wide lower pedestal, deep arched windows on opposite walls, four photovoltaic panels, flared gallery, iron watchroom, two open galleries, clear framed lantern with interior optic and ribbed red dome/vane.
appearance.master: Original complete survey-controlled component construction is preserved byte-exact in an isolated leaf; no mesh or photographic atlas is copied.
appearance.browser: Separate authored regular subdivisions preserve openings, stairs, all four panels, galleries, lantern and full vane height. District/skyline reduce wire, roof ribs and panel grid spacing.
